translations.name: Together TakeMeHome (free HIV self-tests)
translations.description: Get free HIV self-test kits mailed to you with Together TakeMeHome. You must be 17 or older, a US resident, and not have ordered in the past 90 days. The online form takes about 3 minutes. Kits arrive in 1-2 weeks.
translations.website_description: Learn about family planning and sexual health care.
